info.description:
The Scalar Galaxy is an example OpenAPI specification to test OpenAPI tools and libraries. It’s a fictional universe with fictional planets and fictional data. Get all the data for [all planets](#tag/planets/GET/planets). ## Resources * https://github.com/scalar/scalar * https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification * https://scalar.com ## Markdown Support All descriptions *can* contain ~~tons of text~~ **Markdown**. [If GitHub supports the syntax](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/writing-on-github/getting-started-with-writing-and-formatting-on-github/basic-writing-and-formatting-syntax), chances are we’re supporting it, too. You can even create [internal links to reference endpoints](#tag/authentication/POST/user/signup).

package hello.world;

import java.lang.Exception;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import org.scalar.java_sdk.ScalarJavaSDK;
import org.scalar.java_sdk.models.components.*;
import org.scalar.java_sdk.models.operations.CreatePlanetJsonResponse;

public class Application {

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {

        ScalarJavaSDK sdk = ScalarJavaSDK.builder()
            .build();

        PlanetInput req = PlanetInput.builder()
                .name("Mars")
                .description("The red planet")
                .type(Type.TERRESTRIAL)
                .habitabilityIndex(0.68f)
                .physicalProperties(PhysicalProperties.builder()
                    .mass(0.107f)
                    .radius(0.532f)
                    .gravity(0.378f)
                    .temperature(Temperature.builder()
                        .min(130f)
                        .max(308f)
                        .average(210f)
                        .build())
                    .build())
                .atmosphere(List.of(
                    Atmosphere.builder()
                        .compound("CO2")
                        .percentage(95.3f)
                        .build(),
                    Atmosphere.builder()
                        .compound("CO2")
                        .percentage(95.3f)
                        .build(),
                    Atmosphere.builder()
                        .compound("CO2")
                        .percentage(95.3f)
                        .build()))
                .discoveredAt(OffsetDateTime.parse("1610-01-07T00:00:00Z"))
                .image("https://cdn.scalar.com/photos/mars.jpg")
                .satellites(List.of(
                    Satellite.builder()
                        .name("Phobos")
                        .diameter(22.2f)
                        .build()))
                .creator(UserInput.builder()
                    .name("Marc")
                    .build())
                .tags(List.of(
                    "solar-system",
                    "rocky",
                    "explored"))
                .callbackUrl("https://example.com/webhook")
                .build();

        CreatePlanetJsonResponse res = sdk.planets().createPlanetJson()
                .request(req)
                .call();

        if (res.planet().isPresent()) {
            // handle response
        }
    }
}

            .build();

        UpdatePlanetJsonResponse res = sdk.planets().updatePlanetJson()
                .planetId(1L)
                .planet(PlanetInput.builder()
                    .name("Mars")
                    .description("The red planet")
                    .type(Type.TERRESTRIAL)
                    .habitabilityIndex(0.68f)
                    .physicalProperties(PhysicalProperties.builder()
                        .mass(0.107f)
                        .radius(0.532f)

                        .temperature(Temperature.builder()
                            .min(130f)
                            .max(308f)
                            .average(210f)
                            .build())
                        .build())
                    .atmosphere(List.of(
                        Atmosphere.builder()
                            .compound("CO2")
                            .percentage(95.3f)
                            .build(),
                        Atmosphere.builder()
                            .compound("CO2")
                            .percentage(95.3f)
                            .build(),
                        Atmosphere.builder()
                            .compound("CO2")
                            .percentage(95.3f)
                            .build()))
                    .discoveredAt(OffsetDateTime.parse("1610-01-07T00:00:00Z"))
                    .image("https://cdn.scalar.com/photos/mars.jpg")
                    .satellites(List.of(
                        Satellite.builder()
                            .name("Phobos")
                            .diameter(22.2f)
                            .build()))
                    .creator(UserInput.builder()
                        .name("Marc")
                        .build())
                    .tags(List.of(
                        "solar-system",

                    .callbackUrl("https://example.com/webhook")
                    .build())
